firstFailure.origin: Third full Host witness, after original physical window read during first focus preflight; no ordinary focus or HIDE/SHOW issued

event.reason: 窗口或焦点已变化，本次切换已停止。

firstFailure.missingFactsReason: Read aborted in physical-window-observation/after before closing-roster, so rosterRejection/physicalBeforeClosing were not produced. CandidateWorkRect native-catalog rejection carries no snapshot revision, issues, or typed failed-window facts.

sourceChain: CurrentDesktopWindows event loop: snapshot = next; stageEngine.observeEnvironment(next)
StageWindowEngineHost.observeEnvironment rejects incomplete catalog/homeCatalog and calls systemTakesOver
systemTakesOver calls freeze; freeze is the sole host revision increment and invalidates the session while dispatch is held
CandidateWorkRect.independentStageSnapshot reads the same feed.snapshot; native-catalog means catalogComplete != true after freshness and Stage Manager checks
limitations: No freeze callsite/timestamp was logged. Revision 14 is the last completed background sample before failure, followed only by creation (not completion) of revision 15.

Revision 14 full snapshot and catalogIssues/catalogIssueWindows are absent from the archived JSON/JSONL/log evidence. Its specific issue and positive-conflict versus unavailable-observation classification cannot be reconstructed.
Later r4DispatchStateAtFailure is revision 20 and catalogComplete=true; it cannot describe the rejected revision 14 or replace the first error.
observeDirectory only updates the group store; it does not increment Host revision.

clickTiming.envelopeLimitation: This includes retained roster/guards, all attempted original physical window reads and scheduling; it is not isolated AX CPU or native time. The background directory overlaps this envelope and must not be added.

worker.limitation: Native binding/readback receipts establish retained originals and visible state. All Host worker requests have owned=0; no user window hidden-Space lease was acquired and no HIDE/SHOW recovery write is implied.

dock.limitation: First Dock sample expiration follows the witness failure; it is not the first rejection's cause.

evidenceGaps: No per-window Host physical observation begin/end or isolated AX duration for the failed third witness.
No complete revision 14 catalog failure facts in this build; a separate diagnostics-only patch now captures incomplete catalog fields in existing desktop-read-task-exit records.
